name: Stebisha Judin S
description: CrisisX is an integrated disaster management platform designed to support people before, during, and after disasters. The system provides real-time alerts, safety awareness, SOS emergency assistance, AI-based priority assignment, missing person tracking, safe zone navigation, volunteer support, and relief camp resource management. By combining disaster preparedness, response, and recovery into a single platform, CrisisX aims to improve community safety and reduce disaster impact.
